entscheidungen.frage: Fichte uses both Tatsache and the Latin loanword Faktum for "fact"; Kant's "Faktum der Vernunft" stands behind the second. One English word, or a separate one for Faktum?

optionen.en: fact (factum only for Kant's fact of reason and explicit contrasts)
optionen.hinweis: Natural; the German word stays visible in the reader.
Keeps the Latin loanword visible; foreign in running text.
Simplest; the contrast with Tatsache disappears from the page.

entscheidungen.frage: In the 1794 Wissenschaftslehre Leiden is the counterpart of Tun: being acted upon, not pain. Elsewhere Fichte uses it for suffering.

optionen.hinweis: Clear technical sense; one German word, two English words.
Literal, but makes the theory sound emotional.
Scholastic and Kantian echo; easily misread as fondness.

entscheidungen.frage: Fichte's second principle: the I posits a not-I "in opposition" to itself. Should the English keep the verb "posit" inside the word?

optionen.en: oppose; "posit in opposition" where the act is the point
optionen.hinweis: Readable; the act stays visible where it matters.
Keeps "posit" in every occurrence; sounds coined.
Natural English; the link to positing disappears.

entscheidungen.frage: The property of being determined, frequent in Fichte and everywhere in Hegel's logic. The Fichte and Hegel drafts render it differently.

optionen.hinweis: Usual in current translations of Hegel's logic.

entscheidungen.frage: In the 1794 Wissenschaftslehre the Wechsel between I and not-I is a back-and-forth in which each determines the other. In ordinary German it also means change.

optionen.hinweis: Keeps "change" free for Veränderung and Wandel.
Natural, but merges three German words.

entscheidungen.frage: In Fichte's theory of right the person's causal reach into the world. The Hegel draft renders the same word differently.

optionen.hinweis: Usual in current Hegel translations; sounds like success.

entscheidungen.frage: Satz is both a proposition and a law of logic (Satz der Identität, Satz des Grundes). Fichte's Wissenschaftslehre begins from A = A as a Satz.

optionen.en: proposition; principle in named laws (principle of identity)
proposition; law in named laws (law of identity)
optionen.hinweis: Logic-textbook usage; also found in Hegel translations.

entscheidungen.frage: The name for Kant's critical philosophy as a position, above all in Schelling's Philosophical Letters on Dogmatism and Criticism. In English "criticism" usually means finding fault.

optionen.en: criticism, glossed "critical philosophy" at first use
optionen.hinweis: Keeps the established title of the Letters.
A term of art; rare in English.

entscheidungen.frage: Often pejorative: clever reasoning that stays outside its object. Fichte, Schelling and Hegel all use it.

optionen.hinweis: Carries the pejorative edge in context.
Pejorative and Latinate; collides with Kant's vernünfteln.

entscheidungen.frage: For Hegel and Schelling Geist is spirit. In Fichte's Jena psychology it often just means the mind, as in "a pragmatic history of the human Geist".

optionen.hinweis: One word across authors; Fichte's psychology sounds loftier.

optionen.en: spirit by default, mind in Fichte's faculty psychology
optionen.hinweis: Idiomatic in Fichte; the search splits Geist.

optionen.en: mind in Fichte, spirit in Schelling and Hegel
optionen.hinweis: A rule per author; hides the shared vocabulary.

entscheidungen.frage: In 1794 Fichte derives a feeling of oneself from the feeling of limitation. Hegel uses the same word in his anthropology.

optionen.hinweis: Kantian convention; the current standard for all three authors.
Older Fichte convention; collides with Darstellung.

optionen.en: picture-thinking (where Hegel contrasts it with Begriff)
optionen.hinweis: Older Hegel convention; vivid but interpretive.

entscheidungen.frage: Fichte deduces a feeling he calls Sehnen, and writes Sehnsucht in religious contexts. The Schelling draft already gives "longing" to Sehnsucht.

optionen.hinweis: Keeps Fichte's two words apart; clashes with Schelling's Sehnsucht.
One rendering of Sehnsucht across authors.
Simple; the German word stays visible.

entscheidungen.frage: Central to Fichte's ethics (Naturtrieb, reiner Trieb) and to Schelling's nature (Bildungstrieb). Older translations used "impulse".

optionen.hinweis: Current standard for all three authors.

entscheidungen.frage: In the System of Ethics the state of the I as bound or constrained, by its drives and by nature.

optionen.hinweis: Literal; one noun for one noun.
Literal and hyphenated, like other Fichte coinages.

optionen.en: reflective awareness; coming to one's senses

optionen.hinweis: As in a translation of the 1804 lectures; merges four words.
Elegant, but drifts from the sense.

entscheidungen.frage: Kant's word for the mind's faculties (Erkenntnisvermögen). In economic and legal passages it means wealth or assets.

optionen.hinweis: Kantian convention plus a rule by sense.
Natural English; collides with Kraft and Macht.

entscheidungen.frage: The world as given to the senses, Kant's mundus sensibilis. Fichte uses it constantly in his ethics and popular writings.

optionen.hinweis: Older convention, still found for Fichte and Hegel.

entscheidungen.frage: Around Urbild (archetype) Fichte and Schelling use a whole family of image words. The drafts render them differently.

optionen.hinweis: Every word its own English term; "ectype" is rare.

entscheidungen.frage: In the late Fichte Erscheinung is how the absolute, God, shows itself, not a mere phenomenon. Readers of Kant know it as "appearance".

optionen.hinweis: One word across all authors and Kant.

optionen.en: appearance, epiphany where the sense is religious
optionen.hinweis: Vivid; splits one word in two.

entscheidungen.frage: Hegel's begreifen is grasping in the concept; the late Fichte aims at das Unbegreifliche, what cannot be grasped. The drafts disagree.

optionen.hinweis: Current Hegel standard; "incomprehensible" sounds like nonsense.

optionen.en: conceive in Fichte, comprehend in Hegel
optionen.hinweis: Faithful to each; splits one word.

entscheidungen.frage: A coinage of the late Fichte: the capacity of knowing to reflect on itself again and again.

optionen.hinweis: As odd as the German; stays a coinage.

entscheidungen.frage: In the 1804 lectures the Prinzipiat is what a principle grounds, and prinzipiieren is to act as a principle.

optionen.hinweis: Technical coinages, as in the current translation.

entscheidungen.frage: The late Fichte's verb for the intellect's act of seeing into itself, kept apart from denken (to think).

optionen.hinweis: Keeps the Latin root; strange English.

Natural; collides with Verstand and verstehen.

optionen.hinweis: Neutral; loses the link to reason.

entscheidungen.frage: The late Fichte speaks constantly of absolute Einheit; he also writes Einssein (being-one).

optionen.hinweis: Same word as in Kant and Hegel.

optionen.hinweis: Established titles; Sittenlehre is the exception.

optionen.en: theory of right, theory of ethics, theory of the state

entscheidungen.frage: Fichte's account of radical evil starts from Trägheit, the will's tendency to sink back. In physics the same word means inertia.

optionen.en: inertia; sloth where the vice is named
optionen.hinweis: Keeps the physical image Fichte relies on.
The moral vice; loses the physics.
Moral and everyday; neither physical nor theological.

optionen.hinweis: Period English, as in older translations; "race" is loaded today.
Modern and neutral; loses the lineage.

entscheidungen.frage: In Fichte the human or rational species; in Hegel's logic and philosophy of nature the genus (Gattung as against Art).

optionen.en: species in Fichte, genus in Hegel
optionen.hinweis: By sense; the German word stays visible.
Uniform; odd for the human species.
Natural for humans; collides with Hegel's Art.

entscheidungen.frage: Recht is both a right and the law as a system of right. Fichte's and Hegel's philosophies of right turn on it.

optionen.en: right ("law" only for a legal order)

optionen.hinweis: Natural English for the system; loses the moral sense.
Fits some uses; collides with Gerechtigkeit.

entscheidungen.frage: Fichte's Grundlage des Naturrechts and Hegel's essay on Naturrecht. In English "natural law" usually stands for lex naturalis or Naturgesetz.

optionen.hinweis: Current standard for Fichte; keeps "law of nature" free.

optionen.en: natural right in Fichte, natural law in Hegel's title
optionen.hinweis: Keeps both established titles; splits one word.

entscheidungen.frage: Fichte's adjective for what belongs to the order of right, as in rechtliches Verhältnis.

optionen.hinweis: Current standard; a right to do something.
Shorter; could mean a right that coerces.

optionen.hinweis: Plain; collides with Gemeinde and Gemeinschaft.

optionen.en: police, with a note on the period sense
optionen.hinweis: Faithful; modern readers think of officers.
Clear, but loses a term of the period.
A compromise; still sounds like policing.

entscheidungen.frage: The late Fichte's name for the merely provisional state, held together by necessity, as against the state of reason.

optionen.en: state of necessity; right of necessity

entscheidungen.frage: In The Closed Commercial State Fichte contrasts money valid only inside the country with gold and silver valid everywhere.

optionen.hinweis: Explains the idea; not Fichte's words.

entscheidungen.frage: Fichte's national education in the Addresses, but also the upbringing of children in Natural Right.

optionen.hinweis: By sense; the German word stays visible.

entscheidungen.frage: The phrase that started the Atheism Controversy. Fichte insists it is an active ordering (ordo ordinans), not a fixed order.

optionen.hinweis: Established; the note carries Fichte's point.

entscheidungen.frage: From the title of Fichte's 1798 essay on the ground of our belief in a divine Weltregierung.

optionen.hinweis: Older wording; sounds like a cabinet.

entscheidungen.frage: In The Characteristics of the Present Age a people that sets the norm: an original people living by reason as instinct.

optionen.hinweis: Explains the sense; not Fichte's word.

optionen.hinweis: Learned coinage; sharper than the German.

entscheidungen.frage: Fichte's Addresses and Hegel's political writings. Around 1800 the word carries none of its twentieth-century weight.

optionen.hinweis: Literal and period; heavy for modern ears.

The formation of a person, culture, education, and in nature the formation of shapes. The Fichte and Hegel drafts render it differently.

optionen.hinweis: By author and sense; the German word stays visible.

entscheidungen.frage: One of Fichte's favorite conjunctions (923 times). Usually it means "insofar as", but it can also ask "to what extent?".

optionen.en: insofar as ("to what extent" only in questions)
optionen.hinweis: Follows the usage of 1800; needs judgment each time.
Dictionary sense today; often wrong in Fichte.

entscheidungen.frage: In his lecture courses Fichte says "in der vorigen Stunde": in the previous hour, meaning the previous lecture.

optionen.hinweis: What is meant; loses the period idiom.

entscheidungen.frage: Everyday consciousness before philosophy, as against the transcendental standpoint. Gemein here carries no contempt.

optionen.en: Judaism (with a note on the double sense)

optionen.hinweis: Names the community; older, harsher tone.

entscheidungen.deutsch: Period terms for peoples (Neger, Wilde, Barbar)
